title: Circuit Board
look: A chip on a green PCB: black epoxy body edged in tin, copper traces and pads all round, LED eyes.

doc.essence: The character as a component soldered to a printed circuit board: its body a black chip package, its limbs copper traces, its hands tinned pads, its eyes two lit LEDs.
doc.notIt: Not blueprint (a populated board in copper and green, not a white plan), not pixel (no grid snapping), not hologram (solid parts, no light).
doc.shapes: A thin tin edge on every part; the body carries a faint laser-etched dot grid like a chip's surface.
doc.colour: Body black epoxy, bellies a lighter die grey, limbs copper, accents tinned silver, props a red LED, all on solder-mask green.
pitfalls: Copper limbs on copper traces merge: the traces stay out of the character's centre.
The black body needs its tin edge on dark pages.
